items.concept: Establish base-year layer (initial recognition); subsequent four-step DVLIFO measurement schedule for Years 1–3; period-end adjusting JEs to the LIFO reserve (emphasis); presentation of inventory net of allowance
Number-variant twin—base-year establishment; four-step layer schedule; period-end LIFO reserve adjusting JEs for Years 1–3

Adoption of DVLIFO after FIFO years; multi-year layer build; layer liquidation when base-year dollars fall (disposal of newer layers, then base); period-end adjusting JE that decreases the LIFO reserve (emphasis alternate); COGS effect of liquidation
Classification/method—each inventory layer is restated using the price index of the year the layer originated, not the current-year index
